After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''ambush''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sucharme]].

==History==
After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]], now a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], was sent to his [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sucharme]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for what was ostensibly a hero's welcome. Unbeknownst to him, however, Kligson and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were the vanguard of an invasion force.<ref name="EGWAC8" />

Upon their arrival, they received the order to eliminate the leaders of Sucharme in preparation for the [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalization]] of the planet's resources. Believing it to be some kind of mistake, Kligson tried to call of the order. As a result, Kligson was immediately gunned down by his own troops, former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were suspicious of his true loyalties. Not one of the men he had trained and fought beside during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] even hesitated.<ref name="EGWAC8" />

Fortunately for Kligson, the leaders of the [[Grohl Liberation Front]] also had their doubts about the true intentions of the Empire, and had sent [[Agent/Legends|agents]] to spring an ambush of their own. As [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts cut through him, Kligson was rescued by the intervention of the agents.<ref name="EGWAC8" />

Following the ambush, what was left of Kligson was put in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. Most of his body was replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]], most of them made out of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] parts. After he became a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]], Kligson started the construction of a formidable [[Space station/Legends|space station]], derisively dubbed [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]], at the [[Ostega Orbital Yards]].<ref name="EGWAC8" />
